title: Hollow hexagon
description: An online hard-surface mesh with a through-hole, angled sides and sharp corners. Draw on its top or turn it to reach another face.

title: Terrain patch
description: A smooth open heightfield for ridges and contour guides. This slower example uses the measured enclosure route.

title: Curved cylinder
description: A curved closed mesh for comparing flexible direction guidance and preserved guide paths. This slower example uses the recovered field route.

title: Curved guide study
description: A smooth curved surface for drawing open strokes and closed loops. Try a wavy guide, then generate a new quad mesh.
solverNotice: Draw on the surface. Guides influence the quad layout before extraction; results must pass shape, surface and connected-path checks.

title: White toilet — original SKP parts
description: Fresh SketchUp source with separate connected parts and its CAD reference. Open surfaces are preserved.
solverNotice: Select one part and Generate selected, or Work on selected to edit its guides first. Failed attempts retain the source and last accepted result.
